question: What durable state and deterministic policy must ingest.status use for last-error code/category/retry/mutation guidance and snapshot-stable cursor paging without rereading the source or mutating in StatusHandler?
context: TASK-INGEST-STATUS-WORKFLOW is blocked: V001 persists only candidate_receipt.error_code, has no batch-level last-error metadata or paging snapshot, while FR-INGEST-FAILURE-STATUS requires exact durable guidance and the task requires no-skip/no-duplicate paging under a stable snapshot. Resolve the schema/policy and reconcile the bead before implementation.
decision: V002 adds append-only complete BatchErrorEvent metadata written atomically by mutation workflows and ephemeral materialized status snapshots with 15-minute protected cursors. First-page status may write only snapshot state; it never mutates durable workflow state. Later pages read immutable ordinal membership and fail closed on invalid, expired, unknown, or generation-mismatched cursors.
